title: CVaR / expected shortfall
dek: Two books with identical 99% VaR can differ threefold in the tail. Estimating expected shortfall on HYG and VWO — historical and Student-t — and sizing positions with the measure Basel actually chose.
excerpt: VaR marks where the tail begins; CVaR averages what lives inside it. We estimate both at 97.5% and 99% for HYG, VWO and a 50/50 mix across 2007-2024, show VaR breaking subadditivity in crisis-year samples while CVaR never does, count the GFC blowing through HYG's VaR line at 16x its expected frequency, and spend the same 4% tail budget through rm="MV" vs rm="CVaR" in Riskfolio-Lib - with radically different books as the result.
